Mongo.//: Connection string is a SECRET. Do NOT commit it. Provide via user-secrets, environment variable Mongo__ConnectionString, or Azure Key Vault. TLS 1.2+ is enforced by Atlas.

Jwt.//: Signing key and secrets come from user-secrets / Key Vault, never this file.

Encryption.//: Base64 of a 32-byte (256-bit) AES key used to encrypt TOTP secrets at rest. From Key Vault in production.

Email.//: SMTP settings for the email OTP fallback. Password from user-secrets / Key Vault.

Sms.//: Twilio-compatible SMS OTP fallback. Credentials from user-secrets / Key Vault.

Seed.//: First-run bootstrap admin. Password is read from user-secrets/env (Seed__AdminPassword), never committed. Leave empty to skip seeding.
